preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 10,000.
The number of vertices in the graph is between 2 and 200,000.
The number of edges in the graph is between 1 and 200,000.
The start and end vertices of the path are within the range of vertex numbers.
The start and end vertices are not the same.

preconditions.expression: The graph is connected, contains no loops, and has no multiple edges.
preconditions.description: The graph is a simple connected graph.

preconditions.expression: The sum of n over all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5.
preconditions.description: The total number of vertices across all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

preconditions.expression: The sum of m over all test cases does not exceed 2 * 10^5.
preconditions.description: The total number of edges across all test cases does not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.expression: The output is a single number, the number of paths from s to t whose length differs from the shortest path by no more than 1, modulo 10^9 + 7.
postconditions.description: The output must be the count of suitable paths, modulo 10^9 + 7.
